I've been on this land forty years. My head is clear, I read the farming magazines and talk to the agro-station people in Quzhou, but in the end I trust what my own field tells me. Let me think this through.

My 7.7 mu — I'll put about 2 mu in cotton on the sandier corner where water drains fast (cotton likes it), and the remaining 5.7 mu goes into my wheat-maize rotation like always. Cotton prices have not been good these last years, but I still keep a small piece because my wife spins a little and I know the crop.

**Winter wheat (5.7 mu):** I sow in early October. I use an improved variety — Jimai 22 or something similar that the seed dealer brings. Last year I got about 480 kg per mu, the year before 500. I'll aim for 500 again. For fertilizer I apply compound fertilizer 15-15-15 as base — about 50 kg per mu, that gives me 7.5 kg each of N, P, K. Then I top-dress urea at jointing, about 15 kg urea per mu (that's about 7 kg N). So total N around 14-15 kg, P about 7, K about 7. I irrigate at sowing, then green-up, jointing, and grain-filling — four times from the well. Two sprayings for aphids and powdery mildew, sometimes a third if it's wet. I rotary-till after the maize comes off — no time for deep ploughing in the double-crop.

**Summer maize (5.7 mu):** After wheat harvest in June, I no-till seed with the planter right into the stubble — everyone here does this now, saves water and time. Zhengdan 958 or Xianyu 335, hybrid seed. Yield around 550 kg. I put down 40 kg compound as starter and then 20 kg urea at the big trumpet stage — total N about 15 kg, P 6, K 6. One irrigation at tasseling if July rain is short. One spray for corn borer, usually enough.

**Cotton (2 mu):** Bt hybrid cotton, that's the only thing worth planting now because of bollworm. I plough this piece since it's not in rotation with wheat. 50 kg compound as base plus 10 kg urea at flowering and another 10 at boll-setting — N about 14, P 7, K 7. Cotton drinks water — three irrigations. Pesticide I still spray 4 times even with Bt, for aphids, mites, and the late-season bugs. Yield maybe 260 kg seed cotton per mu, the land isn't what it was.
